prereg.goal: give the learner enough authority to actually produce a gait, instead of the six-tibia +-0.003 rad/tick residual that could only trim a stance

action_space.command: rate = base_rate_from_measured_network + tanh(mean) * C(t) / dt, clipped to the frozen +-30 rad/s actuator bound; base_rate = (base_target - actuator.target_rad) / dt
action_space.amplitude_schedule: C(t) = 0.003 + (0.05 - 0.003) * min(1, global_update / 32) rad per 5 ms tick, so the measured-data network acts as a prior that is faded out over the first 32 updates

prereg.reward: reward v3 exactly as recorded in experiments/banc-reward-v3/20261108T090000Z: absolute slip hinge 2*sum max(0, v_i - 0.5*max(|fwd|, v_target))^2, progress clip(fwd/v_target,-1,1.5) doubled below 0.5*v_target, stance foot-speed penalty, attitude, action, support and non-foot terms, terminations COM<0.95 and non-foot>0.05 W
prereg.environment: declared normal adhesion channel active during training (A = 0.5 W per loaded leg, shared across contacts, every 0.5 ms); evaluation is reported BOTH with adhesion off (frozen-body, the honest acceptance number) and with adhesion on (derived-channel)

curriculum.escalation_rule: a level is left only when all five gates pass; if a level's budget is exhausted without passing, the run stops there and the negative result is reported

prereg.gates_note: identical to the frozen verifier quantities used in every previous round; nothing relaxed
prereg.labelling: the controller is a replacement ANN trained by PPO, not a connectome and not brain output; adhesion results are derived-channel and do not change the frozen-body status
prereg.accounting: native steps, wall time, per-update reward, and every gate evaluation are recorded

adhesion.label: derived-channel: results are NOT frozen-body acceptance
